[size=6]Documentation:[/size]

[i](Sam always has post event dialogue. Some events have other villagers also have post event dialogue)
[/i][u][b][color=#ff0000]ATTENTION:[/color][/b][/u] [color=#ea9999]if you pick "Friendship" in event 8 you'll be locked out of the 10 heart event.[/color]

1 Heart Event:
[list]
[*][i]Town[/i]
[*][i]Sunny[/i]
[*][i]11 am - 2 pm[/i]
[*][i]Post-Event-Dialogue: Jas, Penny, Vincent, Sam[/i]
[/list][SPOILER][b]The sky is the limit:[/b]
You meet Sam and Vincent near the playground.
They are about to start a bottle rocket. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

2 Heart Event:
[list]
[*][i]Forest[/i]
[*][i]Sunny[/i]
[*][i]11 am - 2 pm[/i]
[*][i]Post-Event-Dialogue: Sam[/i]
[/list][SPOILER][b]Finding the right tone:[/b]
You walk into Sam playing his guitar but there is something else on his mind. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

3 Heart Event:
[list]
[*][i]Town[/i]
[*][i]Sunny[/i]
[*][i]11 am - 2 pm[/i]
[*][i]Post-Event-Dialogue: Sam, Vincent[/i]
[/list][SPOILER][b]SAM DIES!?!?!?!:[/b]
No he doesn't die.
He just falls on his bum and Vincent is really worried. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

4 Heart Event:
[list]
[*][i]Town[/i]
[*][i]2 pm - 6 pm[/i]
[/list][i][list]
[*][i]Post-Event-Dialogue: Sam, Sebastian, Abigail[/i]
[/list][/i][SPOILER][b]The band:[/b]
Sam and his friends are having band practice.
Sadly things don't work out for Sam as he imagined. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

5 Heart Event:
[list]
[*][i]Beach[/i]
[*][i]5 pm - 8 pm[/i]
[*][i]Post-Event-Dialogue: Sam[/i]
[/list][SPOILER][b]You also lived in Zuzu City?:[/b]
You have a heart to heart with Sam about his struggles. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

6 Heart Event:[i]
[list]
[*]Sam's House
[*]Rainy
[*]10 am - 3 pm
[*]Post-Event-Dialogue: Sam, Vincent, Jodi, Sebastian, (Kent)
[/list][/i][SPOILER][b]Board games:[/b]
You sadly don't get to play board games with Jodi and Vincent >:(.
You instead have to check on Sam, because he's all emotional and stuff. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

7 Heart Event:
[list]
[*][i]Saloon[/i]
[*][i]6 pm - 10 pm[/i]
[*][i]Post-Event-Dialogue: Sam, Vincent, Abigail, Sebastian[/i]
[/list][SPOILER][b]Band falling out:[/b]
Sam is not doing well.
You talk with Abigail and Sebastian what you should do. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

8 Heart Event:[i]
[list]
[*]Railroad
[*]Sunny
[*]8 pm - 11 pm
[*]Post-Event-Dialogue: Sam, Vincent, Sebastian
[*][u][color=#ff0000]ATTENTION:[/color][/u] [color=#ea9999]if you pick "Friendship" you'll be locked out of the 10 heart event.[/color]
[/list][/i][SPOILER]He has come to terms:
Sam is chilling by a campfire and bro is really chill and stuff.
He opens up fully and tells you what decision he made. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

9 Heart Event:
[list]
[*][i]Town[/i]
[*][i]2 or more hearts with Vincent[/i]
[*][i]1 or more hearts with Jodi[/i]
[*][i]Sunny[/i]
[*][i]10 am - 4 pm[/i]
[*]Post-Event-Dialogue: Sam, Vincent, Jodi
[/list][SPOILER]Sam My Rockstar:
You catch Sam looking through old stuff from the attic.
He finds a picture that Vincent drew for him :'). (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

10 Heart Event:
[i][list]
[*][i][color=#ea9999]ONLY IF YOU PICKED "ROMANCE" IN THE 8 HEART EVENT[/color][/i]
[*]You'll get Mail from Sam (the next day after reaching 10 hearts)
[*]...You need to have read that mail
[*]Town
[*]8 pm - 11 pm
[/list][/i][SPOILER]Check out this song!:
Sam invites you over to his place and he wrote a song for you.
Will they kiss at the end??? (play to find out more)

----
Hi most people don't read these SPOILERS, so I had some fun writing these this time, hehe.
Honestly Sam reminds me so much on Sonic the Hedgehog it's wild. Anyway thank you for playing/reading!
﻿- Miihau[/SPOILER]

[size=6]Frequently asked questions:
[/size]
[u]Q:[/u] Is the mod compatible with [color=#f1c232][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#f1c232]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url]﻿[/color]?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] The events account for if Stardew Expanded is installed or not.
     (Besides a tiny little visual error in the 9 heart Event. But it's only noticeable for a few seconds.)

[u]Q:[/u] Can I stay [color=#ffd966]platonic friends[/color] with Sam after 8 Hearts?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#6aa84f]Yes! [/color]Yes in the 8 heart event you will be able to pick to continue as friends or romance.
     BUT you'll be LOCKED OUT of the 10 heart event :3.

[u]Q:[/u] Will the [color=#ffd966]Vanilla Stardew Events[/color] with Sam be [color=#ffd966]replaced[/color]?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#cc0000]No![/color][color=#6aa84f] [/color]This mod only adds more events and does not change any existing events.
     Story wise the Events do not align with the Vanilla events

[u]Q:[/u] Is the mod compatible with[color=#f1c232] any other Sam story mod[/color]﻿?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#6aa84f]Yes! [/color]This mod only adds more events and does not change anything about Sam.
     Not sure if the stories will always fit.

[u]Q:[/u] Can I make a [color=#f1c232]translation[/color] for this mod?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] I am really thankful for any translation.
     Please read the permissions and credits tab first! (no AI).
     Please make sure to use the correct i18n format.
     If you want to use the artwork for your translation or other mod, make sure to credit the original artist.

[u]Q:[/u] Can I use your [color=#f1c232]assets[/color]?
[u]A:[/u] Short answer is [color=#cc0000]no.[/color] But you can reach out to me on Discord to ask for permission (username: [url=https://discordapp.com/users/311172683679268865/]Miihau[/url]).

[u]Q:[/u] Is this mod compatible with [color=#f1c232]mobile[/color]?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#6aa84f]I think so? [/color]So far all of my event mods worked on mobile so I believe this on will as well.[color=#cc0000] [/color]

Q: Can I still see the events if I'm [color=#f1c232]already married[/color] to Sam (or on an already existing save file)?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] You can still see all the event in the intended order.

[u]Q:[/u] Will Sam's [color=#f1c232]behavior change[/color]?
[u]A:[/u][color=#cc0000] No! [/color]This mod does not change her behavior (schedule, gift taste, etc.).

[u]Q:[/u] Can I use your mod as a [color=#f1c232]template to learn[/color]?
[u]A:[/u] [color=#6aa84f]Sure[/color], feel free to learn from it. Just don't blatantly copy whole chunks.

[u]Q:[/u] Will you make a [color=#f1c232]mod for [insert your favorite NPC here][/color]?
[u]A:[/u] So far I have mods for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17674][color=#d5a6bd][u]Haley[/u][/color][/url]﻿,[color=#f4cccc] [/color][color=#8e7cc3][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18657][color=#8e7cc3]Abigail[/color][/url]﻿[/u][/color], [color=#f6b26b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16279][u]Penny[/u][/url]﻿[/color], [color=#b6d7a8][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28299][color=#b6d7a8]Leah[/color][/url]﻿[/u][/color] and [color=#1e84cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24068][color=#1e84cc][u]Shane[/u][/color][/url][/color].
     I really want to make a mod for all the NPCs.
     [color=#9fc5e8]Emily [/color]won my last Mod Vote ;).
     You can vote for who I mod next on my [url=https://miihau.com/home/?tab=modvotebtn]Website[/url].
